categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details) in various villages. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlements, cadastral mapping, and property ownership determinations, which squarely fits the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
